# MeriQuest Client Case Template

Copy this block once per case. One real case becomes thousands of practice clients: MeriQuest automatically varies the personality, mood, tier, channel and location.

> ⚠️ **Anonymise before sharing.** No real names, account numbers, BVN/NIN, phone numbers, emails, addresses or exact balances. Round amounts. (NDPA 2023)

## Example (filled in)

**Case title:** Change of phone number after a stolen phone
**Team:** CX · **Category:** Service request + Fraud & security · **Frequency:** Weekly
**Channels:** Call, WhatsApp, Email · **Tier:** Any · **Where:** Nigeria + diaspora · **Difficulty:** 2

**Client says:** "I've changed my phone number. Please update it on my account so I get my alerts."

**Hidden needs:** 1. The old phone was stolen: possible account-takeover risk.

**Decision 1:**
- ✅ Ask why it changed, flag the takeover risk, and update only with the signed change form, valid ID and a call-back to the verified details.
- ➖ Tell them to visit a branch, without explaining what to bring.
- ❌ Update it immediately on request because they "sound genuine".

**Compliance:** KYC/CDD change-of-details procedure; fraud escalation.
**Growth:** Enrol them in two-step verification and the scam-awareness session on MORE.
